scope: source wiring and regression test verification only; no hosted or VM acceptance claimed
summary: Repaired original Evolution projection filters and authenticated owner read wiring without adding auth infrastructure or treating failures as empty data.
changes: services/control-plane/bff/ports/persona_capital_runtime.py: EvolutionProjectionPort and PersonaCapitalRuntimeDomainPort explicitly accept action_type, risk_level, and status keyword arguments with real filtering; project raw decisions through DomainGovernancePort.project_evolution_decision to map decision_state to status while preserving extra fields (resolved_at); propagate unconfigured or failing reader exceptions as ActionUnavailableError instead of returning fake empty collections.

services/evolution/test_compose_activation.py: Updated EVOLUTION_SCHEDULER_TENANT_ID and EVOLUTION_AUTH_ALLOWED_TENANTS assertions to match the dev selector fallback.

services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_receipt_default_reads.py: Replaced fake EvolutionOwnerHandler with actual Evolution app (services.evolution.main.app), authenticate_tenant middleware, create_program_router, and isolated stores on tmp_path; verified default composition against actual owner auth and collection shape via TestClient transport convention; covered admission, populated reads with static token and tenant forwarding, route-level filters (action_type, risk_level, status), programs list, derived program runs, true empty collection, foreign tenant pre-I/O rejection, and owner 403/503 propagation.

services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_ranking_evolution_projection_ports.py: Added test_list_evolution_decisions_filters_and_projection (action_type, risk_level, status filters, decision_state mapping, no **kwargs sink) and test_evolution_readers_error_propagation (unconfigured and 403/503 error propagation).
